reference.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: single transparent reference sprite for ordinary goblin archer in a 2D idle RPG.
Input images: Image 1 is the approved goblin scout; preserve the species anatomy, head/body proportions, face, short limbs and contour weight. Create its archer variant with the following equipment changes.
Primary request: One small green goblin in a dark GREEN hood and short green tunic, holding a small wooden shortbow in the front/left hand with a plain brown quiver behind its shoulder. Remove the dagger completely. Face LEFT with the same blunt nose, tiny dot eyes, large green pointed ear and compact body as Image 1. No visible neck, very short legs, round brown boots. Front/left hand grips the bow at its CENTER grip. Other/right hand rests close to torso. Exactly two hands and two legs.
Bow construction: a simple wooden arc bulges toward screen LEFT, tips at top and bottom, thin cream bowstring is a straight line between those tips on the RIGHT side of the arc. Bow is shorter than torso-plus-head, not a giant longbow. Quiver is a plain small brown shape behind the back at screen-right, with two short arrow tails peeking out. No arrow nocked in idle pose. Keep a clear small transparent hole between bow and bowstring.
Style/medium: simple flat spot-color raster sprite matching Image 1; broad uniform shapes, minimal interior lines, low-rank ordinary enemy, readable at 48px body height.
Palette: six colors only: #231B15 dark contour/eyes, #70AA4D skin, #3E6D42 hood/tunic, #815337 boots/quiver, #B98750 wooden bow, #E5D7B1 bowstring/arrow tails. No separate shade or highlight areas.
Composition: one full body, LEFT-facing side view with the same mild three-quarter face as reference, neutral feet on same ground line, centered on square with generous margin.
Constraints: true transparent background (do NOT copy reference white background); no gradient, texture, light, shadow or gloss; no text, no logo, no border, no ground shadow, no dagger, no fancy armor, no belts or buckles or extra pouches.

clips.action: breathing loop: 1 neutral stance from reference, both short legs grounded, bow relaxed angled at waist, empty drawing hand down; 2 torso settles slightly lower and wider with gentle breath, same feet and arm lengths.

postprocess_approval: 앞선 사용자 승인에 따라 Pillow로 색면 평탄화. 생성 원본과 알파 보존.

postprocess.normalization: 클립마다 중립 기준 자세로 생성 줌을 맞추고 한 클립 안에는 공통 배율 사용. 걷기는 몸 높이 중간값으로 배율을 맞춤.

verification.runtime_note: 실제 전투. 이번 검증 실행에서만 튜토리얼 가림을 비활성화.
verification.enter_note: 걷기 클립이 있어 실제 이동에는 enter를 재생하지 않음. 두 프레임은 에셋 참조와 미리보기로 확인.

orientation.method: 각 정사각 프레임 내부만 수평 반전. 프레임 순서·알파·RGB 값을 그대로 유지.
